specification: Deviation 13 of docs/analysis_preregistration.md (the corpus description and the commentsCount join); R3, R4 and Deviations 8, 13 and 14; analysis_02_corpus.py

year_totals.note: 2025 covers January to April (the study window ends on 30 April 2025): four months against twelve

join.rule: comment parsedPostId = post parsedId; the largest reported count where a thread has more than one post record (Deviation 13)

capture.method: check_capture_rate.py: captured = unique raw comment ids of a thread; effective denominator = max(commentsCount, captured); a missing commentsCount counts as 0

stages.stage: after submission wrapper strip (79 stripped; 7 fall below word floor)

funnel.checks: the first three stages equal the raw files; the last equals the corpus rows

composition_check_tier_1_and_2.method: Deviation 8 (analysis_01_sample.decomposition), S_e = each era's Tier 1+2 comments
composition_check_tier_1_and_2.note: standardised_era_rates_pooled_frame_mix (the helper's name) holds the era rates standardised to the pooled mix of the three eras' Tier 1+2 comments, not to the draw frame

within_year_sampling_position.method: check_c2_audit.py: year-blocked files, positions within the year, 2016-2024

raw_files.manifest_rule: SHA-256 of the lines 'file name:SHA-256 of the file', sorted by name, joined by a newline, no trailing newline (models_common.pairs_sha256)
